alalal-e16830-d1e101.summary: Rubric marking the division of Lombard's text for Distinction 44 of Book II.

alalal-e16830-d1e108.summary: Places this last distinction of Book II against the whole preceding treatise on sin: it concerns the power of sinning.

alalal-e16830-d1e127.summary: Lombard asks two things: whether the power of sinning is from God, and whether we should resist the sin of wicked rulers ('Hic oritur quaestio').

alalal-e16830-d1e140.summary: Closing remark: the sense of the text is clear from the division.

alalal-e16830.summary: Division of Lombard's text for Distinction 44, the last distinction of Book II, which closes the treatise on sin by considering the power of sinning. Lombard asks whether that power is from God, and whether one must resist the sin of wicked rulers.
